_readme: Monthly Family History Challenge. Adult goals for 2027 follow the ward Temple and Family History plan. id is YYYY-MM. dateNote is shown when a gathering date is not set. Do not invent those dates. link must be an https FamilySearch or Church page that loads. Owned by Sister Shalisa Bingham. Do not add a phone number, email, or other member names.

kids.title: Tell One Tradition
steps: Pick one thing your family does again and again.
Draw it or tell it in a few sentences.
Share it with a parent.

parents.title: Record a Family Tradition
steps: Choose one family tradition.
Record it in writing, photos, or audio.
Add it as a memory in FamilySearch.

together.title: Tradition Night
steps: Do the tradition or tell how it goes.
Let a child tell their part.
Save it together so it is not forgotten.

kids.title: Share One Family Story
steps: Think of one blessing from your family or the temple.
Tell that story in your own words.
Practice it with a parent.

parents.title: 5th Sunday Lesson
steps: Choose one story or testimony of family history and temple work.
Practice telling it in a few minutes.
Share it when the January lesson date is set.

together.title: Practice at Home
steps: Sit together and tell one story from each side of the family you know.
Let a child tell theirs first.
A parent adds what the temple means to your family.

kids.title: Draw the Temple
steps: Draw a temple.
Tell a parent one reason families go there.
Put your picture where you will see it.

parents.title: Login & Recommend Check
steps: Log in to FamilySearch.
See that you can open your family tree.
Schedule a temple recommend interview if yours needs renewing.

together.title: Log In Side by Side
steps: A child sits with a parent while they log in.
Point to one name you both know.
Look at the temple drawing and say why that house matters.

kids.title: Pick a Favorite Photo
steps: Choose one favorite family photo with a parent.
Say who is in the picture.
Watch while it is uploaded.

parents.title: Upload a Photo
steps: Choose that one photo.
Upload 1 photo to FamilySearch.
Add the names of the people in it.

together.title: Upload It Together
steps: Look at the photo together.
Let the child say the names.
A parent uploads it while the child watches.

kids.title: Help Find 1 Name
steps: Sit with a parent at the family tree.
Help look for one person who is missing.
Say that person's name out loud.

parents.title: Find 1 Name
steps: Open your family tree.
Add at least 1 new person.
Check the name with someone who knows the family.

together.title: Add the Name Together
steps: Search side by side.
Let the child help choose the person.
Add that one name before you stop.

kids.title: Thank-You Card and Name Holder
steps: Make a thank-you card to an ancestor.
Decorate a holder for a family name card.
Carry the card to the temple grounds with a parent if you can.

parents.title: Submit Names to the Temple
steps: Prepare at least 1 family name or ordinance card.
Bring it to the temple.
Tell your child the first name on the card.

together.title: Carry the Card
steps: Read the ancestor's name together.
Put the card in the holder the child made.
If you can, walk the temple grounds with that name.

kids.title: Draw Your 4-Generation Tree
steps: Draw you at the bottom.
Add your parents, then your grandparents.
Write a name on each person you know.

parents.title: 4 Generations Check
steps: Open your first 4 generations in FamilySearch.
Verify the names, dates, and places.
Correct them if something is wrong.

together.title: Check While You Draw
steps: A child draws the four generations.
A parent checks those same people on the screen.
Fix one name together if it does not match.

kids.title: Draw the Salt Lake Temple
steps: Look at a picture of the Salt Lake Temple with a parent.
Draw it.
Plan to go when the open house date is shared.

parents.title: Salt Lake Temple Open House
steps: Watch for the official open house dates.
Choose one time your family can go.
Attend one open house event when it is announced.
parents.linkLabel: Open the Salt Lake Temple Page

together.title: Plan the Open House
steps: Look at the child's drawing and the temple page.
Talk about what you hope to see.
Go together when the date is shared.

kids.title: Tell One Story to Save
steps: Pick one family story you love.
Tell it in a few sentences.
Give it to a parent to save.

parents.title: Upload a Story or Document
steps: Choose 1 story or document.
Upload it to FamilySearch.
Attach it to the person it is about.

together.title: Save the Story Together
steps: The child tells the story.
A parent types or scans it.
Upload it while you are still sitting together.

kids.title: Thank-You Card to an Ancestor
steps: Make a thank-you card to one ancestor.
Write or draw why you are glad they are in your family.
Give the card to a parent to take along when the date is set.

parents.title: Ward Temple Day
steps: Watch for the ward temple day date.
Plan to join the ward temple session.
If you cannot attend, prepare a name for someone who can.

together.title: Get Ready for Temple Day
steps: Read the child's card together.
Say the ancestor's name.
Put the date on the calendar when it is announced.

kids.title: A Card for Someone Getting Ready
steps: Make a card for someone in your family who is preparing for the temple.
Draw the temple on it.
Give it to them.

parents.title: Temple Preparation Focus
steps: Finish any ordinance cards you are still holding.
Or help a family member get ready for the temple.
Tell your child one way you helped.

together.title: Prepare Side by Side
steps: A child makes the card.
A parent finishes a card or helps someone prepare.
Give the card to that person together.

kids.title: Five Names Holder
steps: Decorate a holder for five name cards.
Learn five ancestor names with a parent.
Count them on your fingers.

parents.title: Submit 5 Names
steps: Find family names that are ready.
Print at least 5 ordinance cards.
Submit them to the temple.

together.title: Count the Five
steps: Lay the five cards in the holder.
Read each name out loud.
A child keeps the holder while a parent submits the cards.

kids.title: Draw the Tradition
steps: Pick one family tradition.
Draw it or tell how it goes.
Help a parent save it.

parents.title: Record a Family Tradition
steps: Record one tradition in writing, photos, or audio.
Add it as a memory in FamilySearch.
Attach it to the family it belongs to.

together.title: Do It and Save It
steps: Do the tradition or tell it together.
Let each child add one detail.
Save the memory before the night ends.
